owner_decision: The product owner explicitly authorizes real AI-provider calls and API calls necessary for the approved P10E evaluation: paid AI-model inference, semantic embeddings, RAG evaluation, model-quality benchmarking and bounded external API integration testing. This supersedes the P10D restriction against paid evaluation for P10E only.

not_granted.note: Only the first permission (use of paid providers for P10E) was granted, and it carried no monetary ceiling and no call-count limit. Engineering did not invent either.

limits_approval.scope: This approval covers max_spend_usd only. max_provider_calls, the per-request token limits, request_timeout_s, max_retries and max_concurrency are NOT approved yet and remain null; the guard refuses every paid call until each is present, valid and listed in `approves` by the owner.
limits_approval.how_to_approve: Set each remaining limit, add its name to `approves`, and keep approved_by, approval_date and reference, in a reviewed commit. The guard refuses while any limit is missing, invalid, unlisted, unlimited, or a spend limit above spend_authority.approved_total_usd.

spend_authority.decision: The owner approved an initial P10E live-testing budget of USD 10 TOTAL (cumulative across every live run, not per run). USD 15 is the absolute potential ceiling and is NOT the approved spending limit.
rules: The limit is never increased automatically.
Spending above USD 10 requires a separate, explicit owner approval recorded here.
A run's committed upper bound (including worst-case reservations for unknown usage) counts against the total; earlier runs' committed amounts are subtracted before any new call.
